lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct, high-contrast vertical line segments traversing the torso. Spacing is approximately uniform across the midsection, with narrowing intervals observed toward the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 7th line from the anterior, splitting in the lower ventral third of the torso mass. A secondary partial split is visible at the dorsal origin of the 4th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 8, 9, 10, and 11 exhibit significant discontinuities, manifesting as dashed segments that terminate before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 high-contrast circular spots is located on the lateral posterior haunch, with highest density concentrated on the upper-mid thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: A single linear horn spike is visible, projecting at a 45-degree posterior angle relative to the skull base with negligible lyrate curvature.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The apical 15% of the visible horn structure transitions to high-contrast white pixels relative to the darker charcoal-colored base.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron patch between the ocular regions; three white spots on the lower cheek; distinct high-contrast white transverse bands on the distal segments of the forelimbs.
